reason: The PR is centered on `ranger` overflow handling in `pkg/util/ranger/ranger.go`, with a validating change in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_test.go`. In TiDB, range building is tightly coupled to planner/optimizer semantics, and incorrect float/integer overflow handling can change predicate range derivation and cached plan behavior. Even though the main code path is under `util`, this looks materially related to planner correctness rather than an incidental touch.
